author: GamingBolt
description:
Exploration speaks to The Relic: First Guardian’s great strength, where every village, rampart, or cave has a story to tell. Its world is often miserable to traverse, but pockets of humanity shine through its inclement atmosphere. 

The Relic: First Guardian may never escape its technical shortcomings, but its melancholy world is well worth saving.
title: The Relic: First Guardian Review - Diamond In The Rough

author: GamingBolt
description:
Life as a Colonial Marine isn't easy, especially when you're sent to all corners of the universe to deal with the acid-wielding, highly agile and downright homicidal Xenomorphs (and a Synth or two). Nevertheless, it's a job that's never done, as evidenced by Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2. 

Following up on the 2021 co-op shooter from Cold Iron Studios, the sequel is bigger in almost every way, from the number of levels to the actual spaces you'll be fighting in. With its launch set for August 25th on Xbox Series X/S, PS5, and PC, let's break down ten of the biggest changes from the original.
title: Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 vs Aliens: Fireteam Elite 1 - WHAT'S NEW?

author: GamingBolt
description:
GTA 6 feels as far away now as it has for all these long years, but it might be further away for some of us if there happens to be a mismatch between the digital code included with physical copies and our PlayStation accounts. 

An old restriction from Sony might be the biggest obstacle the game faces, placing it squarely in the center of the raging debates about the pitfalls of an all-digital future in modern gaming. 

There are many potential traps and interesting asides to consider as we wade into this murky issue. Join us for a peek at what Sony’s region-locking could mean for PlayStation users wanting to play GTA 6 when it releases.
title: The REAL Problem With GTA 6's Region-Locked PS5 Codes
